parsed.post: Discarding 0.8664. Reverting to my best (ce285ad: 0.8497). The attempt to lower LR to 0.05/0.04 wasn't immediate in this run. I'll pivot to testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 on my best config to see if subtle regularization helps stabilize the depth-6 architecture.
parsed.description: Adding small weight decay (0.01) to the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.1, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1) to test if light regularization improves stability/convergence.
